verdict.rationale: The client SDK exposes a task submission and `run_tasks_until_done` pattern (docs-4, docs-12) plus descriptions of Kosmos autonomously running long, multi-step research (literature review, code execution, hypothesis generation) unattended (docs-5, docs-13, docs-19), supporting the 'long unattended job' half of the story. However there is no evidence of any notification mechanism (email, webhook, push) when a job completes — the only documented pattern is a client-side polling call that blocks until done, not an async notify-on-completion flow. Missing for 10: explicit notification/webhook/email-on-completion feature, evidence of true async fire-and-forget job submission separate from polling.
